purpose: Teach: 会計士/生み出さ/染色/カスタム/補修/公約/不透明/枚数

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 公認会計士、外部監査、もうすぐ、始まりますね。
lines.en: The certified audit will be starting soon.
lines.style: Calm, factual opening. Matter-of-fact tone without urgency. Measured pace. A statement of procedure, not performance. Eyes on the calendar.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、生み出された経緯、社員にも、紹介します。
lines.en: Right. We'll walk the team through how the new product came together.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Steady, collaborative tone. No rush. Each phrase lands clearly. Agreeing to the plan as stated.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 染色のサンプル、最新のもの、提示してね、お客様に。
lines.en: Make sure you show the clients the latest dye samples.
lines.style: Direct but not sharp. Specific instruction delivered with quiet authority. Brief, expectant pause before the period. Assumes competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。カスタムオーダー、対応スタッフ、増員予定です。
lines.en: Got it. We're planning to bring on more staff to handle custom orders.
lines.style: Confirmatory tone. Light emphasis on the expansion detail—it's the newsworthy part. Steady delivery. Professional but engaged.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本社、長年の補修箇所、来期、まとめて、対応しましょう。
lines.en: Let's consolidate the maintenance work at headquarters during the next fiscal year.
lines.style: Gentle directive phrased as collaborative. 'Let's' carries inclusion. Practical tone. No dramatics—this is a sensible plan being stated aloud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営陣の公約、来年度の予算で、実現に向けます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll make it happen with next year's budget allocation.
lines.style: Committed affirmation. Slight warmth—showing alignment with leadership. Professional confidence without overstatement. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界の先行き、不透明な時代こそ、強気で、いきましょう。
lines.en: Now more than ever, when the industry's so uncertain, we need to move forward with confidence.
lines.style: Measured conviction. Opens with calm certainty, builds gentle momentum toward resolve. Steady eye contact. This is Yuki anchoring the moment—not pushing, steadying.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。報告書、枚数、過去最少、を、目指します。
lines.en: Absolutely. We'll aim to make this the leanest report we've ever filed.
lines.style: Enthusiastic agreement. Light lift on 'leanest'—a small win to underscore. Engaged but professional. The closing note of a well-aligned conversation.
